clips.title: The story
paras: Hippogryph Harassment is a local task concerning an aggressive flock of wild hippogryphs nesting southeast of Shen'dar Village. Travelers passing along the nearby road have come under frequent attack from the territorial beasts inhabiting the Shen'dar Highlands. To secure the passage, adventurers are called upon to cull the flock's youths, protectors, and their commanding matriarch.

Travelers navigating the roads near Shen'dar Village face a rising danger from the skies. A wild flock of hippogryphs has recently claimed the rugged territory southeast of the settlement, carving out active nesting grounds in the Shen'dar Highlands. While hippogryphs are known across Kalimdor as noble beasts occasionally bonded to elven riders, untamed flocks guard their territory with fierce ferocity. Any wagon or lone traveler traversing the paths below has become a target for aerial ambushes, disrupting vital passage and leaving the village vulnerable to isolation if the creatures are left unchecked.

To eliminate the immediate threat, the nesting grounds in the Shen'dar Highlands must be directly confronted. Restoring peace to the high roads requires curbing the flock's rapid expansion by taking down their younger members before they reach maturity, as well as breaking through the vigilant hippogryph protectors guarding the perimeter. The true disruption, however, stems from the flock's matriarch, whose leadership directs the attacks on passersby. Only by striking at the nest and felling the matriarch can the roads be made safe once more for travelers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.
